//go:build integration

package postgres_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"reflect"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/infrastructure/persistence/postgres"
	studentuc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/student"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// Root alone runs this migrated PostgreSQL owner proof. Initial profile/path
// and frozen upstream material are named metadata fixtures created through
// owner repositories. Consequences are named Planner wire contract fixtures;
// this test proves Student application, not Planner policy qualification.
// The separate composed actual gate delivers the real Planner consequence.
func TestT204HybridApplicationPostgres(t *testing.T) {
	dsn := os.Getenv("STUDENT_T204_DATABASE_URL")
	if dsn == "" {
		t.Skip("root-owned T20.4 PostgreSQL gate absent")
	}
	cfg, err := pgxpool.ParseConfig(dsn)
	if err != nil || cfg.ConnConfig.Host != "127.0.0.1" || cfg.ConnConfig.Port != 58999 || cfg.ConnConfig.Database != "remediation_t20_student_integration_proof" {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: exact isolated T20 database required")
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 120*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	pool, err := pgxpool.NewWithConfig(ctx, cfg)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer pool.Close()
	repo := &postgres.LearningJourneyRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	t.Run("intent and future permutation atomic replay", func(t *testing.T) {
		path := t204InitialOwnerPath(t, ctx, pool, false)
		snapshot := t204Snapshot(t, ctx, repo, path)
		one, two := 1, 2
		ops := []domain.HybridFutureMutation{{Kind: "REORDER_PENDING_ITEMS", ItemID: path.Items[1].ID, TargetPosition: &two}, {Kind: "REORDER_PENDING_ITEMS", ItemID: path.Items[2].ID, TargetPosition: &one}}
		intent := t204Intent(snapshot, "SUBSTANTIAL_SCOPE_CHANGE", ops)
		before := t204Counts(t, ctx, pool, path)
		constraint := "t204_intent_failure_" + strings.ReplaceAll(intent.IntentID, "-", "")
		if _, err := pool.Exec(ctx, fmt.Sprintf(`ALTER TABLE student_outbox ADD CONSTRAINT %s CHECK(causation_id<>'%s') NOT VALID`, constraint, intent.IntentID)); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		defer func() {
			_, _ = pool.Exec(context.Background(), "ALTER TABLE student_outbox DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS "+constraint)
		}()
		if _, err := repo.CreateHybridLearningIntent(ctx, path.StudentID, intent); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("intent outbox failure did not abort")
		}
		if got := t204Counts(t, ctx, pool, path); got != before {
			t.Fatalf("failed intent partially committed before=%v after=%v", before, got)
		}
		if _, err := pool.Exec(ctx, "ALTER TABLE student_outbox DROP CONSTRAINT "+constraint); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		stored, err := repo.CreateHybridLearningIntent(ctx, path.StudentID, intent)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		intent.CreatedAt = intent.CreatedAt.Add(time.Hour)
		replay, err := repo.CreateHybridLearningIntent(ctx, path.StudentID, intent)
		if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(stored, replay) {
			t.Fatalf("server time altered exact intent replay %v", err)
		}
		changed := intent
		changed.Kind = "CHANGE_GOAL"
		changed.RequestedChange.Scope.GoalCode = "go.changed"
		if _, err = repo.CreateHybridLearningIntent(ctx, path.StudentID, changed); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrHybridConflict) {
			t.Fatalf("changed same intentID accepted %v", err)
		}
		competing := intent
		competing.IntentID = uuid.NewString()
		if _, err = repo.CreateHybridLearningIntent(ctx, path.StudentID, competing); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrHybridConflict) {
			t.Fatalf("competing exactrevision intent accepted %v", err)
		}
		if _, err = repo.GetHybridLearningIntent(ctx, uuid.NewString(), path.ID, intent.IntentID); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
			t.Fatalf("foreign intent disclosed %v", err)
		}
		withIntent := t204Snapshot(t, ctx, repo, path)
		if withIntent.PendingIntent == nil || withIntent.PendingIntent.IntentID != intent.IntentID || withIntent.References.SnapshotRef == snapshot.References.SnapshotRef {
			t.Fatal("durable intent missing from coherent owner identity")
		}
		c := t204Consequence(withIntent, ops)
		c.ApplicationMode = domain.HybridApplicationRequiresIntent
		c.IntentID = intent.IntentID
		c.RequiredIntentKind = intent.Kind
		c.ReasonCodes = []string{"EXPLICIT_LEARNER_INTENT", "REQUIRES_LEARNER_INTENT"}
		before = t204Counts(t, ctx, pool, path)
		failed := "t204_receipt_failure_" + strings.ReplaceAll(c.ConsequenceID, "-", "")
		if _, err = pool.Exec(ctx, fmt.Sprintf(`ALTER TABLE student_hybrid_application_receipt ADD CONSTRAINT %s CHECK(consequence_id<>'%s') NOT VALID`, failed, c.ConsequenceID)); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		defer func() {
			_, _ = pool.Exec(context.Background(), "ALTER TABLE student_hybrid_application_receipt DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS "+failed)
		}()
		if _, err = repo.ApplyHybridConsequence(ctx, c); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("receipt failure did not abort future application")
		}
		if got := t204Counts(t, ctx, pool, path); got != before {
			t.Fatalf("application partial transaction before=%v after=%v", before, got)
		}
		if failedSnapshot := t204Snapshot(t, ctx, repo, path); failedSnapshot.References != withIntent.References {
			t.Fatal("rollback rewrote path, material, intent or context")
		}
		if _, err = pool.Exec(ctx, "ALTER TABLE student_hybrid_application_receipt DROP CONSTRAINT "+failed); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		type applicationAttempt struct {
			receipt domain.HybridApplicationReceipt
			err     error
		}
		attempts := make(chan applicationAttempt, 2)
		for n := 0; n < 2; n++ {
			go func() { r, e := repo.ApplyHybridConsequence(ctx, c); attempts <- applicationAttempt{r, e} }()
		}
		first, second := <-attempts, <-attempts
		result, err := first.receipt, first.err
		if err != nil || second.err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(result, second.receipt) || result.Status != domain.HybridApplicationApplied || result.ResultingRevision != path.Version+1 {
			t.Fatalf("concurrent exact matching intent application %#v %v / %#v %v", result, err, second.receipt, second.err)
		}
		updated, err := repo.GetLearningPathByID(ctx, path.StudentID, path.ID)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(updated.Items[0], path.Items[0]) || updated.Items[1].ID != path.Items[2].ID || updated.Items[2].ID != path.Items[1].ID {
			t.Fatal("future permutation touched current private assignment or failed exact slots")
		}
		consumed, err := repo.GetHybridLearningIntent(ctx, path.StudentID, path.ID, intent.IntentID)
		if err != nil || consumed.ConsumedAt == nil || consumed.ConsumedByConsequenceID != c.ConsequenceID {
			t.Fatal("successful intent was not consumed once atomically")
		}
		after := t204Counts(t, ctx, pool, path)
		if after[0] != before[0]+1 || after[1] != before[1]+1 || after[3] != before[3]+1 || after[4] != before[4]+1 || after[6] != before[6]+1 || after[7] != before[7]+1 {
			t.Fatalf("one application revision/context/receipt/consumption expected before=%v after=%v", before, after)
		}
		for n := 0; n < 3; n++ {
			exact, err := repo.ApplyHybridConsequence(ctx, c)
			if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(exact, result) {
				t.Fatalf("lost ACK replay %v", err)
			}
		}
		if got := t204Counts(t, ctx, pool, path); got != after {
			t.Fatal("replay mutated owner counters")
		}
		for _, query := range []string{`UPDATE student_learning_intent SET kind=kind WHERE intent_id=$1`, `DELETE FROM student_learning_intent WHERE intent_id=$1`} {
			if _, err = pool.Exec(ctx, query, intent.IntentID); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("consumed intent provenance mutated")
			}
		}
		for _, query := range []string{`UPDATE student_hybrid_application SET payload_hash=payload_hash WHERE consequence_id=$1`, `DELETE FROM student_hybrid_application WHERE consequence_id=$1`, `UPDATE student_hybrid_application_receipt SET receipt_json=receipt_json WHERE consequence_id=$1`, `DELETE FROM student_hybrid_application_receipt WHERE consequence_id=$1`} {
			if _, err = pool.Exec(ctx, query, c.ConsequenceID); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("immutable application/receipt mutated")
			}
		}
		c.ReasonCodes = []string{"NO_SIGNIFICANT_CHANGE"}
		if _, err = repo.ApplyHybridConsequence(ctx, c); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrHybridConflict) {
			t.Fatalf("same consequenceID changedpayload accepted %v", err)
		}
		t.Log("actual intent+outbox and future permutation+revision+journey+receipt+consumption commit atomically; rollback/replay preserve protected private row")
	})
	t.Run("no change and coherent stale fence", func(t *testing.T) {
		path := t204InitialOwnerPath(t, ctx, pool, false)
		s := t204Snapshot(t, ctx, repo, path)
		c := t204Consequence(s, []domain.HybridFutureMutation{})
		c.Outcome = domain.HybridOutcomeNoChange
		c.ApplicationMode = ""
		c.ReasonCodes = []string{"NO_SIGNIFICANT_CHANGE"}
		before := t204Counts(t, ctx, pool, path)
		receipt, err := repo.ApplyHybridConsequence(ctx, c)
		if err != nil || receipt.Status != domain.HybridApplicationNoChange || receipt.ResultingRevision != path.Version {
			t.Fatalf("nochange %#v %v", receipt, err)
		}
		after := t204Counts(t, ctx, pool, path)
		if after[0] != before[0] || after[1] != before[1] || after[6] != before[6] || after[4] != before[4]+1 {
			t.Fatal("nochange created path revision or failed receipt")
		}
		stalePath := t204InitialOwnerPath(t, ctx, pool, false)
		old := t204Snapshot(t, ctx, repo, stalePath)
		stale := t204Consequence(old, []domain.HybridFutureMutation{})
		stale.Outcome = domain.HybridOutcomeNoChange
		stale.ApplicationMode = ""
		stale.ReasonCodes = []string{"NO_SIGNIFICANT_CHANGE"}
		t204OfficialEvidence(t, ctx, pool, stalePath, 1)
		before = t204Counts(t, ctx, pool, stalePath)
		if _, err = repo.ApplyHybridConsequence(ctx, stale); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrHybridStale) {
			t.Fatalf("fresh mastery with samepathversion did not invalidate consequence %v", err)
		}
		if after = t204Counts(t, ctx, pool, stalePath); after != before {
			t.Fatal("stale consequence mutated owner state")
		}
	})
	t.Run("exact intent unstarted READY replacement", func(t *testing.T) {
		path := t204InitialOwnerPath(t, ctx, pool, false)
		s := t204Snapshot(t, ctx, repo, path)
		op := domain.HybridFutureMutation{Kind: "REPLACE_ACTIVE_ACTIVITY", ItemID: path.Items[0].ID, TemplateItemID: path.Items[1].ID}
		intent := t204Intent(s, "REPLACE_ACTIVE_ACTIVITY", []domain.HybridFutureMutation{op})
		if _, err := repo.CreateHybridLearningIntent(ctx, path.StudentID, intent); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		s = t204Snapshot(t, ctx, repo, path)
		c := t204Consequence(s, []domain.HybridFutureMutation{op})
		c.ApplicationMode = domain.HybridApplicationRequiresIntent
		c.IntentID = intent.IntentID
		c.RequiredIntentKind = intent.Kind
		c.ReasonCodes = []string{"EXPLICIT_LEARNER_INTENT", "REQUIRES_LEARNER_INTENT"}
		receipt, err := repo.ApplyHybridConsequence(ctx, c)
		if err != nil || receipt.Status != domain.HybridApplicationApplied {
			t.Fatalf("safe READY replacement %#v %v", receipt, err)
		}
		updated, err := repo.GetLearningPathByID(ctx, path.StudentID, path.ID)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if updated.Items[0].ID != path.Items[0].ID || updated.Items[0].Position != path.Items[0].Position || updated.Items[0].Status != domain.LearningPathItemReady || string(updated.Items[0].LessonContent) != string(path.Items[1].LessonContent) || !reflect.DeepEqual(updated.Items[1:], path.Items[1:]) {
			t.Fatal("READY replacement changed execution identity or future source")
		}
		t.Log("actual exact learner intent replaces only unstarted READY material, preserving occurrence identity/position/status")
	})
	t.Run("unselected application preserves independent selected and paused paths", func(t *testing.T) {
		selected := t204InitialOwnerPath(t, ctx, pool, false)
		cloneInitial := func() domain.StudentLearningPath {
			p := selected
			p.ID = uuid.NewString()
			p.CourseID = uuid.NewString()
			p.IsPrimary = false
			p.IsSelected = false
			p.Version = 1
			p.Items = append([]domain.LearningPathItem{}, selected.Items...)
			for n := range p.Items {
				p.Items[n].ID = uuid.NewString()
			}
			created, replay, err := repo.CreateLearningPathIdempotently(ctx, p, repository.LearningPathCreationRequest{IdempotencyKey: uuid.NewString(), PlanningRequestID: uuid.NewString(), RequestHash: strings.Repeat("b", 64)})
			if err != nil || replay {
				t.Fatalf("named second initial owner path %v", err)
			}
			return created
		}
		unselected := cloneInitial()
		paused := cloneInitial()
		journey, err := repo.GetLearningContext(ctx, paused.StudentID)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		// Ordinary path lifecycle commands bind the aggregate journey version,
		// which includes both additional path admissions, not path revision 1.
		if _, err := repo.PauseLearningPath(ctx, paused.StudentID, paused.ID, journey.Version, time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond)); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		selectedBefore, err := repo.GetLearningPathByID(ctx, selected.StudentID, selected.ID)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		pausedBefore, err := repo.GetLearningPathByID(ctx, paused.StudentID, paused.ID)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		var selectedID, status string
		var version int64
		if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT selected_learning_path_id::text,selected_path_status,version FROM student_learning_context WHERE student_id=$1`, selected.StudentID).Scan(&selectedID, &status, &version); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		s := t204Snapshot(t, ctx, repo, unselected)
		one, two := 1, 2
		c := t204Consequence(s, []domain.HybridFutureMutation{{Kind: "REORDER_PENDING_ITEMS", ItemID: unselected.Items[1].ID, TargetPosition: &two}, {Kind: "REORDER_PENDING_ITEMS", ItemID: unselected.Items[2].ID, TargetPosition: &one}})
		c.ReasonCodes = []string{"EXISTING_PREREQUISITE_GAP"}
		if _, err := repo.ApplyHybridConsequence(ctx, c); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		var afterID, afterStatus string
		var afterVersion int64
		if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT selected_learning_path_id::text,selected_path_status,version FROM student_learning_context WHERE student_id=$1`, selected.StudentID).Scan(&afterID, &afterStatus, &afterVersion); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if afterID != selectedID || afterStatus != status || afterVersion != version+1 {
			t.Fatal("unselected application changed independent selected context")
		}
		selectedAfter, err := repo.GetLearningPathByID(ctx, selected.StudentID, selected.ID)
		if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(selectedBefore, selectedAfter) {
			t.Fatal("unselected application changed selected owner path")
		}
		pausedAfter, err := repo.GetLearningPathByID(ctx, paused.StudentID, paused.ID)
		if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(pausedBefore, pausedAfter) {
			t.Fatal("unselected application changed paused owner path")
		}
	})
	t.Run("frozen equivalent replacement and accepted gap contract insertion", func(t *testing.T) {
		for _, kind := range []string{"REPLACE_PENDING_ITEM_WITH_EQUIVALENT_SAME_GOAL_ITEM", "INSERT_FUTURE_REMEDIATION"} {
			t.Run(kind, func(t *testing.T) {
				path := t204InitialOwnerPath(t, ctx, pool, false)
				s := t204Snapshot(t, ctx, repo, path)
				op := domain.HybridFutureMutation{Kind: kind, ItemID: path.Items[1].ID, TemplateItemID: path.Items[0].ID}
				if kind == "INSERT_FUTURE_REMEDIATION" {
					position := 1
					op.TargetPosition = &position
					op.NewItemID = uuid.NewString()
				}
				intent := t204Intent(s, "SUBSTANTIAL_SCOPE_CHANGE", []domain.HybridFutureMutation{op})
				if _, err := repo.CreateHybridLearningIntent(ctx, path.StudentID, intent); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				s = t204Snapshot(t, ctx, repo, path)
				c := t204Consequence(s, []domain.HybridFutureMutation{op})
				c.ApplicationMode = domain.HybridApplicationRequiresIntent
				c.IntentID = intent.IntentID
				c.RequiredIntentKind = intent.Kind
				c.ReasonCodes = []string{"EXPLICIT_LEARNER_INTENT", "REQUIRES_LEARNER_INTENT"}
				if kind == "INSERT_FUTURE_REMEDIATION" {
					c.ReasonCodes = append(c.ReasonCodes, "EXISTING_PREREQUISITE_GAP")
					sort.Strings(c.ReasonCodes)
				}
				receipt, err := repo.ApplyHybridConsequence(ctx, c)
				if err != nil || receipt.Status != domain.HybridApplicationApplied {
					t.Fatalf("frozen material %s %#v %v", kind, receipt, err)
				}
				updated, err := repo.GetLearningPathByID(ctx, path.StudentID, path.ID)
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				if !reflect.DeepEqual(updated.Items[0], path.Items[0]) || string(updated.Items[1].LessonContent) != string(path.Items[0].LessonContent) || updated.Items[1].LessonRevisionID != path.Items[0].LessonRevisionID {
					t.Fatal("frozen template not reused exactly or protected source mutated")
				}
				if kind == "INSERT_FUTURE_REMEDIATION" {
					if len(updated.Items) != len(path.Items)+1 || updated.Items[1].ID != op.NewItemID || updated.Items[2].ID != path.Items[1].ID {
						t.Fatal("insertion lost existing occurrence")
					}
				} else if updated.Items[1].ID != path.Items[1].ID || updated.Items[1].Position != path.Items[1].Position {
					t.Fatal("equivalent replacement changed occurrence identity")
				}
			})
		}
	})
	t.Run("open Practice remains active and major intent waits", func(t *testing.T) {
		path := t204InitialOwnerPath(t, ctx, pool, true)
		actions := postgres.LearningActionLifecycleRepoPG{Pool: pool}
		practiceOwner := studentuc.PracticeLearningActions{Actions: actions, Clock: t204OwnerInputs{}, IDs: t204OwnerInputs{}}
		instance := uuid.NewString()
		digest := "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("c", 64)
		binding, err := practiceOwner.Reserve(ctx, domain.PracticeLearningActionReserve{Schema: domain.StudentPracticeLearningActionReserveSchema, StudentID: path.StudentID, TaskInstanceID: instance, IdempotencyKey: instance, TaskRevisionID: path.Items[0].ReferenceID, TaskRevisionDigest: digest, SurfaceClassification: "project", LearningTargets: path.Items[0].Targets, LearningPathID: path.ID})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		binding, err = practiceOwner.Open(ctx, path.StudentID, instance, binding.LearningActionID)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		path, err = repo.GetLearningPathByID(ctx, path.StudentID, path.ID)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		t204OfficialEvidence(t, ctx, pool, path, 8)
		s := t204Snapshot(t, ctx, repo, path)
		c := t204Consequence(s, []domain.HybridFutureMutation{{Kind: "SKIP_REDUNDANT_PENDING_ITEM", ItemID: path.Items[1].ID}})
		receipt, err := repo.ApplyHybridConsequence(ctx, c)
		if err != nil || receipt.Status != domain.HybridApplicationApplied {
			t.Fatalf("safe future while currentOPEN %#v %v", receipt, err)
		}
		afterBinding, err := actions.GetPracticeLearningAction(ctx, path.StudentID, instance)
		if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(binding, afterBinding) {
			t.Fatal("safe future changed active Practice binding")
		}
		updated, err := repo.GetLearningPathByID(ctx, path.StudentID, path.ID)
		if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(updated.Items[0], path.Items[0]) {
			t.Fatal("future application changed current execution")
		}
		path = updated
		s = t204Snapshot(t, ctx, repo, path)
		intent := t204Intent(s, "REMOVE_ACTIVE_PROJECT", []domain.HybridFutureMutation{{Kind: "REMOVE_ACTIVE_PROJECT", ItemID: path.Items[0].ID}})
		if _, err = repo.CreateHybridLearningIntent(ctx, path.StudentID, intent); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		s = t204Snapshot(t, ctx, repo, path)
		c = t204Consequence(s, intent.RequestedChange.Mutations)
		c.ApplicationMode = domain.HybridApplicationRequiresIntent
		c.IntentID = intent.IntentID
		c.RequiredIntentKind = intent.Kind
		c.ReasonCodes = []string{"EXPLICIT_LEARNER_INTENT", "REQUIRES_LEARNER_INTENT"}
		before := t204Counts(t, ctx, pool, path)
		for n := 0; n < 2; n++ {
			receipt, err = repo.ApplyHybridConsequence(ctx, c)
			if err != nil || receipt.Status != domain.HybridApplicationWaitingSafeBoundary || receipt.ResultingRevision != path.Version {
				t.Fatalf("active major proposal %#v %v", receipt, err)
			}
		}
		after := t204Counts(t, ctx, pool, path)
		if after[0] != before[0] || after[1] != before[1] || after[3] != before[3]+1 || after[4] != before[4] || after[7] != before[7] {
			t.Fatalf("WAITING created terminal receipt/revision/consumption before=%v after=%v", before, after)
		}
		storedIntent, err := repo.GetHybridLearningIntent(ctx, path.StudentID, path.ID, intent.IntentID)
		if err != nil || storedIntent.ConsumedAt != nil {
			t.Fatal("waiting consumed intent")
		}
		currentBinding, err := actions.GetPracticeLearningAction(ctx, path.StudentID, instance)
		if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(currentBinding, binding) {
			t.Fatal("waiting changed Practice-owned execution")
		}
	})
	t.Log("PASS actual Student owner intent/application PostgreSQL boundary; named Planner consequence fixtures, no Planner evaluator policy claim")
}

type t204OwnerInputs struct{}

func (t204OwnerInputs) Now() time.Time { return time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond) }
func (t204OwnerInputs) NewID() string  { return uuid.NewString() }

func t204InitialOwnerPath(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool, practice bool) domain.StudentLearningPath {
	t.Helper()
	sid := uuid.NewString()
	now := time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond)
	profile := domain.StudentOnboarding{StudentID: sid, DirectionCode: "backend", SelfAssessedExperience: "basic", KnownStacks: []string{}, DesiredStacks: []string{"go"}, GoalCode: "go.backend", PreferredLanguage: "en", WeeklyMinutes: 60, PreferredPace: "standard", Version: 1, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now}
	if _, err := (&postgres.StudentOnboardingRepoPG{Pool: pool}).Save(ctx, profile, 0); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	target := domain.LearningTargetRef{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "t204.exact-owner-boundary", Version: "v1"}
	path := domain.StudentLearningPath{ID: uuid.NewString(), StudentID: sid, CourseID: uuid.NewString(), GoalCode: "go.backend", CourseFingerprint: "named-t204-upstream-frozen-course-v1", PolicyVersion: domain.LearningPathPolicyVersion, PlannerPolicyVersion: "course-planner-v1", ReasonCode: "initial_plan", ReasonSummary: "Named initial owner path and frozen metadata; no evidence/finalstate injected", Status: domain.LearningPathStatusActive, Version: 1, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now}
	for n := 0; n < 4; n++ {
		item := domain.LearningPathItem{ID: uuid.NewString(), ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: uuid.NewString(), LessonRevisionID: uuid.NewString(), Position: n, Status: domain.LearningPathItemPlanned, ReasonCode: "current_gap", Targets: []domain.LearningTargetRef{target}, LessonContent: json.RawMessage(fmt.Sprintf(`{"title":"Named frozen lesson %d","private_marker":"retained-material-%d"}`, n, n)), FrozenRequirements: []domain.LessonRequirement{{ID: uuid.NewString(), ActivityID: uuid.NewString(), Type: "theory_acknowledged", Required: true, SourceReference: domain.LessonSourceReference{ID: uuid.NewString()}}}}
		if n == 0 {
			item.Status = domain.LearningPathItemReady
			if practice {
				item.ReferenceType = "practice"
				item.LessonRevisionID = ""
				item.FrozenRequirements = nil
				item.LessonContent = nil
			}
		}
		path.Items = append(path.Items, item)
	}
	path, replay, err := (&postgres.LearningJourneyRepoPG{Pool: pool}).CreateLearningPathIdempotently(ctx, path, repository.LearningPathCreationRequest{IdempotencyKey: uuid.NewString(), PlanningRequestID: uuid.NewString(), RequestHash: strings.Repeat("a", 64)})
	if err != nil || replay {
		t.Fatalf("initial owner fixture %v", err)
	}
	stored, err := (&postgres.LearningJourneyRepoPG{Pool: pool}).GetLearningPathByID(ctx, path.StudentID, path.ID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return stored
}
func t204Snapshot(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, repo *postgres.LearningJourneyRepoPG, path domain.StudentLearningPath) domain.StudentPlanningSnapshot {
	t.Helper()
	targets := path.Items[0].Targets
	source, err := repo.ReadPlanningSnapshot(ctx, path.StudentID, path.ID, targets)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	snapshot, err := domain.BuildStudentPlanningSnapshot(source, domain.PlanningSnapshotRequest{Targets: targets, TriggerContext: domain.PlanningSnapshotTrigger{Kind: "synthetic_received_Planner_contract_fixture", Reason: "actual Student owner application proof"}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return snapshot
}
func t204Consequence(s domain.StudentPlanningSnapshot, ops []domain.HybridFutureMutation) domain.HybridConsequence {
	ops = append([]domain.HybridFutureMutation{}, ops...)
	sort.Slice(ops, func(i, j int) bool { return ops[i].ItemID < ops[j].ItemID })
	scope := domain.HybridScopeIdentity{GoalCode: s.Path.GoalCode, DirectionCode: s.Profile.DirectionCode, DesiredStacks: append([]string{}, s.Profile.DesiredStacks...)}
	c := domain.HybridConsequence{Schema: domain.HybridConsequenceSchema, StudentID: s.StudentID, LearningPathID: s.LearningPathID, ExpectedPathRevision: s.Path.Version, SnapshotRef: s.References.SnapshotRef, SnapshotTargets: s.RequestedTargets, PolicyVersion: domain.HybridReplanPolicyVersion, PolicyInputHash: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("a", 64), Outcome: domain.HybridOutcomeReplanNeeded, ApplicationMode: domain.HybridApplicationAuto, ReasonCodes: []string{"TARGET_MASTERED_STABLE"}, BaselineScope: scope, DesiredScope: scope, Mutations: ops}
	c.ConsequenceID = uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceURL, []byte("planner-hybrid-consequence.v1\x00"+c.StudentID+"\x00"+c.LearningPathID+"\x00"+c.SnapshotRef+"\x00"+c.PolicyVersion)).String()
	return c
}
func t204Intent(s domain.StudentPlanningSnapshot, kind string, ops []domain.HybridFutureMutation) domain.HybridLearningIntentProjection {
	return domain.HybridLearningIntentProjection{IntentID: uuid.NewString(), StudentID: s.StudentID, LearningPathID: s.LearningPathID, ExpectedPathRevision: s.Path.Version, Kind: kind, CreatedAt: time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond), RequestedChange: domain.HybridRequestedChange{Scope: domain.HybridScopeIdentity{GoalCode: s.Path.GoalCode, DirectionCode: s.Profile.DirectionCode, DesiredStacks: append([]string{}, s.Profile.DesiredStacks...)}, Mutations: ops}}
}
func t204OfficialEvidence(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool, path domain.StudentLearningPath, count int) {
	t.Helper()
	apply := studentuc.ApplyPracticeEvidence{Evidence: &postgres.LearningEvidenceRepoPG{Pool: pool}}
	for n := 0; n < count; n++ {
		id := uuid.NewString()
		bundle := domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundle{Schema: domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidenceSchemaV1, PolicyVersion: domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidencePolicyV1, EvidenceID: id, SubmissionID: id, StudentID: path.StudentID, TaskInstanceID: uuid.NewString(), TaskRevisionID: uuid.NewString(), Outcome: "passed", AssistancePolicyVersion: "teacher-assistance-v1", Evidence: []domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidence{{Target: path.Items[0].Targets[0], Correctness: 1, Independence: 1, Confidence: 1, StepIDs: []string{"named-upstream-runtime-proof-step"}}}, OccurredAt: time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond)}
		if _, err := apply.Handle(ctx, path.StudentID, id, bundle); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
}

// pathversion, revisions, intents, application admissions, terminal receipts,
// intent-trigger outbox, journeyversion, consumed intents.
func t204Counts(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool, path domain.StudentLearningPath) [8]int64 {
	t.Helper()
	var c [8]int64
	err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT p.version,(SELECT count(*) FROM student_learning_path_revision WHERE student_learning_path_id=p.id),(SELECT count(*) FROM student_learning_intent WHERE learning_path_id=p.id),(SELECT count(*) FROM student_hybrid_application WHERE learning_path_id=p.id),(SELECT count(*) FROM student_hybrid_application_receipt r JOIN student_hybrid_application a USING(consequence_id) WHERE a.learning_path_id=p.id),(SELECT count(*) FROM student_outbox WHERE student_id=p.student_id AND subject='student.planning-state.changed.v1' AND payload->'data'->>'trigger_kind'='LEARNING_INTENT'),(SELECT version FROM student_learning_context WHERE student_id=p.student_id),(SELECT count(*) FROM student_learning_intent WHERE learning_path_id=p.id AND consumed_at IS NOT NULL) FROM student_learning_path p WHERE p.id=$1`, path.ID).Scan(&c[0], &c[1], &c[2], &c[3], &c[4], &c[5], &c[6], &c[7])
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return c
}
